jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Product Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.
Job Title: Sr. Product Manager, Product Lifecycle

The Sr. Product Manager, Product Lifecycle will act as the single-threaded business owner for product financial rigor and lifecycle sunset strategy within the Product Lifecycle organization. Reporting to the Director of Product Roadmap, this role bridges product decision-making and financial discipline, ensuring that every device and software feature in the Vivint portfolio is evaluated, priced, and eventually sunset based on rigorous, standardized unit economics.

This is a foundational, 0-to-1 role. You will build the first standardized Product P&L framework used across the product organization, and you will stand up Vivint's first generalized End-of-Life (EOL) process from the ground up. You will partner closely with Supply Chain, Sales, Finance, and core Product Managers to ensure that pricing, component cost, and sunset decisions are grounded in data rather than instinct, and that product leadership always has a clear, current view of financial health across the live portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities

Product P&L & Unit Economics

- P&L Standardization: Design and roll out a standardized profit-and-loss framework that product teams can use consistently to evaluate the cost, margin, and profitability of any device or software offering.

- Component & Pricing Strategy: Partner with Supply Chain and Sales to align component costs and sales pricing to margin targets, ensuring pricing decisions are backed by defensible financial data.

- Financial Performance Monitoring: Build and maintain the mechanisms that track ongoing product financial performance, including margin health, warranty drag, and upgrade subsidy costs, flagging deviations to product and finance leadership.

- Business Case Development: Partner with the Director of Product Roadmap and core Product Managers to build rigorous, data-backed business cases for new investment, extension, or sunset decisions.

EOL Strategy & Process

- EOL Process Design: Own the end-to-end design of Vivint's first standardized, cross-functional End-of-Life process, including trigger criteria, governance and approval steps, and a repeatable sunset playbook for hardware and software.

- Legacy Portfolio Assessment: Partner with the Roadmap team to assess the current live and legacy device fleet, using financial modeling to identify and prioritize EOL candidates.

- Upgrade & Migration Economics: Model the financial tradeoffs of customer upgrade paths and subsidy structures, balancing customer retention costs against margin recovery.

- Cross-Functional Rollout: Partner with Sales, Customer Support, and Marketing to build the operational playbook needed to communicate and execute product sunsets smoothly.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

- Financial Modeling Mastery: Exceptional proficiency building P&L models, margin analysis, and unit economics; advanced Excel or equivalent modeling tools required.

- Process Design Mindset: Proven ability to build a 0-to-1 process or framework from ambiguity and drive adoption across a cross-functional organization.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Strong track record building trust and aligning priorities across Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and Product without relying on direct authority.

- Data Fluency: Comfortable working with large, complex data sets to support financial modeling; working knowledge of SQL or BI tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI) is a plus.

Required Education & Experience

- Experience: 6-8+ years of experience in product finance, FP&A, business operations, or a finance-focused product strategy role, ideally within consumer electronics, IoT, or subscription-based hardware businesses.

- Lifecycle Exposure: Direct experience building or significantly maturing a product P&L framework, pricing model, or end-of-life/lifecycle process is highly preferred.

- Cross-Functional Track Record: Demonstrated success partnering across finance, supply chain, and product teams to influence pricing, margin, or portfolio decisions.

- Education: B.S. or M.S. in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline; MBA preferred.

Job Functions:

Position requires in-office presence in Seattle, WA on a hybrid schedule for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday with a work from home day on Friday. The position will start remote and then will move into the hybrid schedule.

The base salary range for this position is: $155,000 - $190,000* *The base salary range above represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonus, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition the position may be eligible to participate in the benefits program which include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending accounts.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Product Usage
jobs.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

The Senior Manager of Product Usage & Insights will act as a single-threaded business and data owner responsible for analyzing how customers interact with the Vivint smart home ecosystem. This role focuses on translating post-launch device telemetry, customer support data, and operational metrics into actionable insights. You will bridge the gap between real-world product performance and future state design, serving as a critical insights engine for core Product Managers.

In this role, you will dive deep into device usage patterns, troubleshooting calls, and product issues to identify functional gaps and roadmap opportunities. You will operate cross-functionally to aggregate data across the business, while also spearheading the development of internal AI and data tools to help team members more efficiently understand customer behavior and business trends. Your ultimate mission is to ensure our product teams have the deep data required to evolve features, optimize hardware, and deliver a seamless customer experience.

Primary Responsibilities

Product Usage Analysis & Diagnostic Insights

- Usage Tracking & Behavioral Data:  Analyze high-volume device telemetry and behavioral data to understand how, when, and why customers use specific smart home products on a daily basis.

- Troubleshooting & Escalation Deep-Dives:  Partner with Customer Operations and Technical Support to systematically audit troubleshooting calls, hardware failure rates, and customer friction points.

- Gap & Opportunity Identification:  Translate real-world product issues and negative customer experiences into clearly defined product gaps, presenting data-backed optimization opportunities to core Product Managers.

Roadmap Support & Cross-Functional Data Enablement

- Data-Backed Roadmap Input:  Support core Product Managers by providing empirical data and usage baselines to inform 1-to-2 year product roadmaps and feature prioritization.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Operate as the central hub for product insights, collaborating daily with Supply Chain (on hardware reliability), Marketing (on feature adoption), Research (on user sentiment), and Operations (on field issues).

- Business Telemetry Modeling:  Synthesize disparate data streams into unified, scannable dashboards and operational metrics that accurately reflect the health and performance of the live product portfolio.

Internal AI Tool Development & Efficiency

- Internal AI Enablement:  Lead the conceptualization and deployment of internal generative AI, search, or analytical tools designed to help internal teams query and understand complex product and business data more efficiently.

- Insights Democratization:  Build automated reporting mechanisms and data repositories that allow non-technical stakeholders to quickly extract trends regarding product usage and operational performance.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

- Analytical Mastery:  Exceptional proficiency in data manipulation and statistical analysis. Baseline skills in SQL, data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI), and Excel are required.

- Root-Cause Troubleshooting Mindset:  Strong diagnostic instincts with the ability to look past surface-level symptoms in customer support logs to identify underlying firmware, hardware, or software flaws.

- Cross-Functional Influence:  Proven ability to build strong working relationships and align priorities across diverse corporate functions without relying on direct authority.

- Emerging Tech & AI Literacy:  Solid understanding of how to apply basic data science workflows or leverage low-code/no-code internal AI frameworks to automate business intelligence.

Required Education & Experience

- Experience:  4–6+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, operations framework management, or a data-focused product management role.

- Ecosystem Exposure:  Direct experience working within consumer electronics, IoT, telecommunications, or subscription-based software services is highly preferred.

- Cross-Functional Track Record:  Demonstrated success aggregating data from operations, supply chain, or customer support teams to drive business or product changes.

- Education:  B.S. or M.S. in Data Analytics, Business Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related quantitative discipline; equivalent practical analytical experience considered.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management Partner Experiences
jobs.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Position Summary:

The Director of Product Management for Partner Experiences is the single-threaded owner responsible for the strategy, technical roadmap, and end-to-end integration of third-party (3P) partner devices into the Vivint Home ecosystem. Operating as a high-impact, independent strategic leader, you will expand the boundary of the smart home by enabling external hardware—such as smart lighting, advanced climate controls, multi-vendor sensors, and entertainment platforms—to work seamlessly alongside Vivint’s proprietary hardware suite.

This is an individual contributor role requiring a highly technical product leader who can operate autonomously without a direct team of direct reports. You will specialize in developing deep technical relationships with engineering and product teams at world-class technology companies, leveraging their specialized expertise to accelerate Vivint’s ecosystem growth. You will bridge the gap between external APIs/protocols and internal architecture to deliver zero-friction, deeply integrated consumer experiences at scale.

Primary Responsibilities

- Strategic Ecosystem & Integration Roadmap

- 3P Partner Roadmap Ownership: Own the multi-year product strategy, prioritization, and technical execution blueprint for all third-party device integrations within the Vivint Home ecosystem.

- Strategic Partner Evaluation: Serve as the organization’s primary scout and thought leader on identifying external technical partners whose hardware expertise can fill critical portfolio gaps and unlock "new-to-world" smart home experiences.

- Seamless Interoperability Standards: Define the strict performance, security, and user experience baselines that external hardware partners must meet to ensure flawless, native performance inside the Vivint app ecosystem.

- Technical Execution & Architecture Alignment

- Cross-Organizational Architecture: Partner with internal Core Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, and Information Security teams to design scalable, secure SDKs and APIs that facilitate low-latency 3P device communication.

- Standards Advocacy: Drive Vivint’s product alignment with emerging smart home industry standards (such as Matter, Thread, and specialized cloud-to-cloud APIs) to simplify external onboarding and future-proof the ecosystem.

- Technical Authoring: Independently write data-driven strategy narratives, business requirements documents (BRDs), and product definitions (PRFAQs) to gain executive alignment on high-stakes ecosystem expansion opportunities.

- Influence, Negotiation & Partnership Development

- External Technical Diplomacy: Act as the primary technical product interface to external partners' product and engineering organizations, steering their roadmaps to align with Vivint’s architectural needs. Including negotiating and owning the partner relationships.

- Matrixed Internal Influence: Operate with extreme autonomy to influence, unblock, and drive execution across internal cross-functional peer organizations, including Software, Legal, UX Design, and QA Engineering teams.

- Lifecycle Governance: Build rigorous integration testing and post-launch telemetry review mechanisms to continuously evaluate the performance, stability, and customer satisfaction of third-party hardware integrations.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

- Autonomous Individual Contribution: Proven track record of operating with complete strategic independence. You must excel at leading via cross-functional influence without relying on administrative reporting lines.

- Integration & API Literacy: Deep technical understanding of cloud-to-cloud integrations, local wireless mesh topologies (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread), device driver layers, and platform-level SDK development.

- Ecosystem Design Thinker: Exceptional systems-thinking capability with a focus on creating frictionless user experiences when combining hardware and software assets from completely distinct corporate entities.

- Executive Presence & Narrative Construction: Superb written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to command technical discussions with external executives and synthesize complex partnership logistics into clear execution milestones for internal leadership.

Required Education & Experience

- Experience: 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 4+ years explicitly focused on building developer platforms, partner API ecosystems, IoT integrations, or connected smart home environments.

- Partnership Track Record: Demonstrated experience leading complex, technical product integrations with tier-1 consumer electronics or software enterprise partners.

- Matrixed Project Delivery: Proven success driving large-scale, multi-phase technical hardware or software launches across highly distributed, multi-disciplinary organizations.

- Education: B.S. or M.S. in a Technical Field (Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related discipline); equivalent practical engineering experience considered.
